description.value: Jazen Tea is a BC-based bubble tea chain specializing in fruit teas, milk teas, smoothies, and slushies made with real whole fruits and high-quality Taiwanese tea leaves. The brand emphasizes fresh ingredients, including lactose-free milk and real blended fruit, across its franchise locations. A stop here offers a refreshing, fruit-forward drink option for cyclists passing through North Vancouver.
